metadata.description: Backend architecture documentation generated from source code analysis

ConfigModule.description: Global configuration module using @nestjs/config with environment variables

DatabaseModule.description: TypeORM database connection module with PostgreSQL/SQLite auto-detection

AuthModule.description: Authentication module with JWT strategy, Google OAuth, GitHub OAuth

ProductsModule.description: Product CRUD with AI 3D model generation, image upload, filtering, and recommendations

CategoriesModule.description: Category management with hierarchical support and SEO metadata

OrdersModule.description: Order management with status tracking, items, and customer data

CartModule.description: Shopping cart management with quantity and price calculations

UploadModule.description: File upload handling with Cloudinary integration and local fallback for images, 3D models, and section assets

AiGenerationModule.description: AI-powered 3D model generation with multi-provider support (OpenAI, Tripo3D, local Python worker)

MessagesModule.description: Contact form messages with status tracking and admin responses

SectionsModule.description: Homepage sections management with multilingual content, 3D models, and variant support

PagesModule.description: Dynamic CMS pages with slug-based routing, templates, and SEO metadata

SettingsModule.description: Key-value settings storage with type support (string, number, boolean, json) and categories

NotificationsModule.description: In-app notification system with types, status tracking, and user targeting

PaymentsModule.description: Payment processing with LiqPay and Stripe support, webhook handling, and status tracking

RecommendationsModule.description: Product recommendation engine with similar products, bought-together, and personalized recommendations

SeoModule.description: SEO metadata management for pages and products

EmailModule.description: Email sending service using Nodemailer with SMTP configuration

HealthModule.description: Health check endpoints for application monitoring

CommonModule.description: Shared utilities, filters, interceptors, and helpers

endpoints.description: List products with filtering, pagination, and search
Trigger AI 3D model generation for a product
List orders (admin: all, user: own only)
Upload product image to Cloudinary or local storage
List sections with optional pageTarget filter
Get all settings (public for frontend config)

SMTP/Nodemailer.purpose: Email sending for order confirmation, contact form notifications, password reset

OpenAI.purpose: AI-powered 3D model generation and image processing

UAV Mapping.notes: Local Python worker exists but integration is partial

backend/src/.ai-generation/: AI 3D model generation with multi-provider support

guards.JwtAuthGuard: Extends AuthGuard('jwt'), validates token and attaches user to request
guards.AdminGuard: CanActivate guard that checks user.role === UserRole.ADMIN

oauthProviders.google: Implemented with Passport Google OAuth2 strategy
oauthProviders.github: Implemented with Passport GitHub OAuth2 strategy

knownTechnicalDebt: Payment entity uses orderId as plain number instead of TypeORM relation to Order
Notification entity has userId but no @ManyToOne relation defined
CartItem entity references User and Product via plain IDs without cascade delete relations in some cases
Some DTOs lack comprehensive validation decorators
Error handling is inconsistent across controllers (some use try-catch, some rely on global filter)
No rate limiting implemented for public endpoints
Swagger documentation is configured but may not cover all endpoints
Redis/BullMQ configuration exists but queue-based processing is limited
